brief.zh: 先只拨最右边的开关，比较前后读数。再在第二组里只拨最左边的开关。两次各变了多少？
brief.en: Flip just the far-right switch in the first case. In the second case, flip just the far-left switch. How much does each reading change?

concept.zh: 把开关位置对应到位权
concept.en: Connect each switch to its place value

label.en: Start at 010 and flip the right lamp
Start at 0011 and flip the left lamp
